text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original checks, conditions and short-circuit order, so behaviour is unchanged. The added `k > 0` in `IsPayloadCall` is redundant for the expression-body loop, where `k` starts at `body.Start + 1`. The remaining methods each look well under 15 in cognitive complexity, and I see no unused variables or parameters that would trip warnings-as-errors.
